svg.text: Frames: MuJoCo simulation, 1:5 model on a 36° staircase

g.text: heading held by the IMU PID
Slow to a stop over 1 s: front on
the landing, rear on the last steps

svg.text: No distance reading in step 1: drive forward 3 s instead of step 2
Speeds are fractions of the 1500 counts/s maximum (cruise 1000 counts/s, leaving room for the heading correction). Thresholds are first estimates.
A long press on the knob or a serial stop command ends the sequence at any step.
